# teams_tenant_network_region (Data Source)

Look up an existing TenantNetworkRegion object. Set identity to select it.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `identity` (String) Identity used to look up the object.

### Read-Only

- `bypass_id` (String) Maps to the -BypassID parameter.
- `central_site` (String) Maps to the -CentralSite parameter.
- `description` (String) Maps to the -Description parameter.
- `id` (String) Object identifier (GUID).
- `network_region_id` (String) Maps to the -NetworkRegionID parameter.
